sys_script_include.description: Owns the x_gegis_ins_policy_uw_guideline_version lifecycle only: creates the next version header row for a submission_line (version = current max + 1, is_latest flipped). Does not decide WHY a version is created (UWTriggerReasonResolver's job) and does not populate rule_group/criterion child rows or score/risk_level/decision (a future scoring flow's job - see the HOOK POINT comment in createNextVersion). createNextVersion is deliberately public/callable so a future "Recalculate" UI Action can call it directly - there is no DB event for a button click.
sys_script_include.name: UWGuidelineVersionService
